When describing the pain, she says that she feels intermittent shocks down both arms and legs, and also notes a diffuse ache in her neck and lower back. Physical examination reveals some numbness in her hands and thighs, as well as diffuse spine tenderness. MRI of scans of her entire spine show increased tumor burden in her lumbar and cervical spine causing multiple areas of severe stenosis. You are also able to identify new lesions seeding her peritoneum.
